summary: 2026-27 home kit. The chest carries the 'Severstal' lettering (the club's general sponsor) per the KHL press-service kit review; the club's partners page names Olimpbet, Vostok Service and Q Center as official partners and Sovcombank as official bank. Back and sleeve placements could not be verified from an openable source; media/information partners listed by the club (Sports.ru, TV Start, Sovetsky Sport) are not modelled as kit sponsors.
